name: SHOOT N SPELL
summary: Welcome to SHOOT N SPELL, a high-energy, brain-boosting virtual reality game developed for wireless standalone VR devices. In this unique word-action experience, players must react quickly to shoot or strike the correct letters of a given word as they appear in full 360° motion. Each of the seven levels introduces new environments and weapons—from fast-paced gunplay in Tunnel, to slicing words mid-air in Word Slice, to physically boxing your way through Word Boxing.
